mapper.select: SELECT match_id, goal_id, publish_version, first_role_key, second_role_key, state FROM w16_role_content_binding WHERE match_id=#{matchId}
SELECT state FROM w16_role_content_publication WHERE goal_id=#{goalId} AND publish_version=#{publishVersion}
SELECT body FROM w16_role_content_body WHERE goal_id=#{goalId} AND publish_version=#{publishVersion} AND role_key=#{roleKey}
SELECT ticket_id, actor_id, match_id, goal_id, publish_version, role_key, secret_ref FROM w16_role_content_grant WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w16_role_content_grant(ticket_id, actor_id, match_id, goal_id, publish_version, role_key, secret_ref) VALUES(#{ticketId}, #{actor}, #{matchId}, #{goalId}, #{publishVersion}, #{roleKey}, #{secretRef})
